creative_brief.emotional_promise: Turn one quiet palm-sized sculpture into a tiny two-creature theatre with one ordinary room light and one decisive quarter-turn.
creative_brief.format_rationale: Four compact 5 by 7 inch portrait pages give the one-piece toy a complete box-ready teaching arc without inflating it into a technical booklet; every page has one dominant owner task.
creative_brief.physical_format: Four-page 5 by 7 inch portrait pocket booklet
teaching_arc: Meet the one-piece toy and gather the ordinary room-light setup
Stage phone, toy, and wall with exact distance and orientation cues
Find the owl silhouette on the first broad face
Rotate the whole toy 90 degrees to find the rabbit
Recover from blur or stretch, then care for and store the toy safely
typography: Body and captions — embedded Bitstream Vera
creative_brief.visual_motif: Rounded eclipse panels, a moon-gold beam, broad silhouette cards, and exact product poses echo the caster’s crown and whole-object rotation.

findings: The first render showed missing-glyph boxes in the page-two light-order strip, cover cue, and page-four panel icons, breaking the most important setup diagram in both color and grayscale.
The first setup strip did not visually disambiguate phone, toy, wall, beam direction, and both distances.
The exact silhouette pair needed a nearby consumer-facing qualifier because physical phone-light clarity and human recognition were not observed.
resolved_changes: Replaced the broken glyph strip with a font-safe vector side view labeled PHONE, TOY, and WALL, including the beam arrow and both distance bands.
Removed every unsupported Unicode icon and replaced panel markers with embedded-font-safe characters.
Added a qualifier beside the owl and rabbit outlines stating that edge clarity varies with phone, room, and wall, and darkened the moon accent for stronger grayscale hierarchy.
